event.title: England Secures Third Place with 6-4 Victory Over France in World Cup Thriller
event.canonical_title: England Secures Third Place with 6-4 Victory Over France in World Cup Thriller
event.summary: In a thrilling World Cup third-place playoff, England triumphed over France with a score of 6-4. Bukayo Saka's hat-trick played a crucial role in England's victory, marking their best finish in the tournament since 1966. Despite the loss, Kylian Mbappé scored twice, setting a new record for the most goals in World Cup history with 22.

timeline.title: England Secures Third Place with 6-4 Victory Over France in World Cup Thriller
timeline.summary: In a record-breaking World Cup third-place playoff, England defeated France 6-4. Bukayo Saka scored a hat trick, helping England to a significant lead of 4-0 at halftime. Despite a spirited comeback from France in the second half, England held on to secure their best World Cup finish since 1966.
key_facts: England won 6-4 against France in the World Cup 2026 third-place playoff.
Bukayo Saka scored a hat trick for England.
France mounted a comeback but ultimately lost.
